headline: GST Appellate Tribunal Rules Airlines Can Claim Refunds on Cancelled Tickets
summary: The GST Appellate Tribunal ruled that airlines can claim Goods and Services Tax refunds on cancelled tickets provided the fare and tax are returned to passengers.
why: Tax refund rulings for common carriers affect operating cash flows and resolve compliance disputes within the commercial aviation sector.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Recovering previously remitted taxes on refunded fares improves working capital recovery for commercial airlines.
